title: USF-219 backup restore DR and RPO/RTO operational proof depth

boundaries.title: Bounded local pgBackRest cold backup and restore proof
boundaries.nonEquivalenceBoundary: USF-211 proves a profile-gated local cold backup and restore readback with synthetic data only. It is not online backup, WAL archive, PITR, scheduled backup operation, DR rehearsal, RPO/RTO achievement, environment promotion, provider-managed backup, live-provider readiness, production readiness, SOC readiness, ISO certification, full dev readiness, full product readiness, or USF-133 closure.
boundaries.nonClaimBoundary: Only bounded local cold backup/restore proof is accepted.

boundaries.title: Online backup and WAL archive evidence
requiredEvidence: execute online backup against the authorised local boundary
prove WAL archive configuration and value-free evidence
prove failure behaviour and safe teardown
boundaries.nonClaimBoundary: This boundary is not proven by USF-219 and remains assigned to USF-223 before any backup, restore, DR, PITR, RPO, RTO, environment readiness, live-provider, production, SOC, ISO, full-dev, full-parity, or USF-133 closure claim.

boundaries.title: PITR and scheduled backup operation evidence
